subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this issue stay open as the broad Anthropic signed-thinking replay umbrella, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining prevention issue now that recovery slices landed?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are on main, but the remaining prevention path changes Anthropic thinking replay semantics and has multiple related open PRs with compatibility and provider-contract tradeoffs.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split and close the remaining variants.

options.title: Make narrower issue canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its linked fix PR.

options.title: Defer prevention policy
options.body: Treat recovery as sufficient for now and keep prevention work paused until provider replay policy is revisited.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split and close the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already tied to the landed recovery discussion and the replay-preservation commit metadata, making him the best available routing owner for the umbrella-versus-narrow-canonical decision.
